'''2001 Denver World Qualifier warm-up tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG warm-up on 29 June 2001. [[Jason Keen]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2575">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-03-denver-world-qualifier-weekend-day-oned2575/ denver-world-qualifier-weekend-day-one], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 3 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-03-denver-world-qualifier-weekend-day-oned2575/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Denver World Qualifier]].

* '''Date:''' 29 June 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jason Keen]]
